annotation.organism: Emericella nidulans (strain FGSC A4 / ATCC 38163 / CBS 112.46 / NRRL 194 / M139)
function: Component of the regulatory network controlling carbon source utilization through ubiquitination and deubiquitination involving creA, creB, creC, creD and acrB. Required to prevent the proteolysis of the CreB deubiquitinating enzyme in the absence of carbon catabolite repression. CreB deubiquitinating enzyme stabilized in a complex with the CreC leads to the expression of genes such as those in the proline and quinate pathways.
similarity: Belongs to the WD repeat creC family.
